title: Koe no Katachi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: This is the 2011 one-shot that became A Silent Voice. Grade-schooler Shoya Ishida leads his class in bullying Shoko Nishimiya, a deaf transfer student, until she leaves the school and he is blamed and shunned in turn. Years later he seeks her out to make amends, having learned sign language.
life_message: Cruelty leaves lasting wounds, but honest regret and effort to make amends can open a path to forgiveness.
